# dokku_ps_scale (Data Source)

Manages the process scale for a given dokku application

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_ps_scale" "example" {
  app = "hello-world"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Name of the app

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
- `scale` (Map of Number) Map of process types to quantities
